column3: Sets the labor scene at the palm trunk immediately before the commanded shaking and ripe fruit.

Uses falling in a temptation context unrelated to fruit released by shaking.
Concerns adherence to revelation, adding no detail to the provision scene.
Frames the promised child whose birth context culminates in the palm's provision.

Supplies the water below Mary that accompanies the palm fruit in the same immediate scene.
